body.text: The office MFA system has been updated. Scan the QR code below with your phone camera, then enter your password and OTP code.
Accounts that have not re-registered will be locked at 17:00.

explanation: A QR code (the square pattern you scan with a phone camera) is just a link in picture form, and this one leads to nusadigital-mfa.test, not the office domain. The real IT team never asks for your password and OTP by email.
hints: Even a picture can hide a link. Where does it lead?
Compare the sender's domain and the QR code's destination with nusadigital.test.
